en-US.longDescription: JadeAI is an AI-powered smart resume builder. Build professional resumes with drag-and-drop editing, real-time AI optimization, 50 professional templates, PDF and image resume parsing, JD match analysis, and multi-format (PDF/HTML/DOCX) export. Open source and free, with one-click Docker deployment.
